title: SGB bought and sold on the exchange: listed non-equity security, LT after 12 months, 12.5 % under s.112, no Rs 1.25 lakh exemption
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.47(viic) covers only redemption by RBI, not a sale on the exchange -> taxable transfer
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso (as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024): listed security -> long-term if held more than 12 months

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024: LTCG on transfer on/after 23-Jul-2024 taxed at 12.5 % without indexation (s.48 second proviso indexation only for transfers before 23-Jul-2024)
s.112A threshold applies only to s.112A assets (STT-paid equity) - not to SGB
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance (No.2) Act 2024 s.2)
derivation: Buy on exchange 2023-03-10: 10 @ 5,500.00 -> cost 55,000.00 (not an original subscriber).
Sale on exchange 2025-02-10: 10 @ 8,500.00 -> proceeds 85,000.00; not an RBI redemption -> taxable.
Held 2023-03-10 -> 2025-02-10 (23 months > 12) -> long; transfer after 23-Jul-2024 -> 12.5 % without indexation.
